questions.prompt: A production API started returning intermittent 500s after a deploy. Walk through how you would diagnose and stabilize the service within the first hour.
Design an API for creating and updating orders that must remain correct under retries and duplicate client requests.
Your team needs to add a new feature that touches three services. How would you sequence the work to reduce integration risk?
A junior engineer repeatedly ships code that passes tests but fails code review for clarity and maintainability. How do you coach them?
Explain how you would introduce observability to a service that currently only has basic uptime checks.
You inherit a monolith that is slowing delivery. What signals tell you whether to modularize in place versus extract a service?
Given the job description, outline a 30-day technical onboarding plan for a mid-level engineer joining this team.
Propose a testing strategy for the core workflow described in the posting, including what you would automate first.
The posting mentions scale concerns. Identify the two most likely bottlenecks and how you would validate them before building.
Draft a security review checklist you would apply before shipping the first milestone of this role's primary project.
Describe how you would run a design review for a feature in this domain so product, engineering, and support stay aligned.
A stakeholder wants the feature in half the estimated time. How do you respond without over-promising?

dimensions.label: Structure
dimensions.description: The response is organised, sequenced, and complete.

dimensions.label: Reasoning
dimensions.description: Decisions are justified with cause-and-effect thinking.

dimensions.label: Domain correctness
dimensions.description: The response uses sound engineering practice and terminology.
